name: What if the damage seems minor—do I still need emergency help?
description: Yes, if water got inside. Small visible damage can hide bigger problems behind walls, under floors, or above ceilings.

mainEntity.name: What if the damage seems minor—do I still need emergency help?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the damage looks small, it can still be worth calling because water often travels behind walls and under floors where it is not obvious. A good emergency team can tell you whether you need full restoration right away or just monitoring, which is often cheaper than waiting until the problem spreads.
